rev6.release_notes: The taskbar button shows the G00 logo (it showed a blank white and green icon).

cadcam.release_notes: Program It: makes only a program that passes its own checks, else says plainly what stops it; asks Replace / Add after / Cancel on a part that already has a program. New mill posts: Doosan DNM4500 (Fanuc), Brother R450X1 (Speedio), Haas VF-2SS (Next Gen). Turning: a neutral insert held off both walls of a ring groove; Groove no longer rapids through stock left by a Roughing; 1/32 nose radius written R0.0313. Right-click a file tab: New, Open, Close (a file always stays open). TRAIN is now TRAIN AI; LEARNED has a book icon. Backup: every save also writes the same file into your backup folder. Sketch: dimension to a part's edge, Delete removes a dimension, a fainter grid over a part, a sketch on a picked face no longer stays blue. Quick Setup: one value box while dragging the origin, measured from where the drag started. Simulate: new ball nose end mill and neutral holder models. Faster undo and autosave; safer AI connection.
